Inline diff limit
mpd.jsonc hashline.maxDiffChars — a save writes <workspace>/.mpd/mpd.jsonc for the live session workspace(s) and takes effect for the mpd plugins after a restart (this knob is read at plugin mount) — it applies at the next dsh boot, because the file-derived base is fixed for the running process's lifetime the value is never lost: it is stored in the host settings document and the config layer applies it to every workspace immediately — only the file write waits for exactly one live session
